title: Harry the Dancing Hippo

pages.text: Harry was a very large hippo who loved to do very small, graceful ballet dances.
One day, he put on a pink tutu and tried to spin, but he accidentally made a huge splash in the lake!
The monkeys laughed, but Harry just bowed and said, 'That was my special water-ballet move!'
Soon, all the animals were in the water, splashing and dancing along with Harry.

moral: Being yourself is the best way to have fun and make others smile.
